name: void-supercode
description: Void SuperCode - A lightweight code editor

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && npx copyfiles -u 2 src/renderer/*.html src/renderer/*.css dist/renderer && npx copyfiles -u 4 node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs/**/* dist/renderer/vs && npx copyfiles -u 3 src/renderer/icons/*.svg dist/renderer/icons && npx copyfiles icon.png dist
